title: Like every song
prompt: Song is supplied. Write public static List<Song> LikeAll(List<Song> songs). Return a new list holding a liked copy of every song, in the same order. The list passed in must not change: it keeps the same items, and they are still not liked.
hints: A List is a class. If you change the list you were given, who else sees the change?
Create a new list for the result, and add a changed copy of each song to it.
Loop over songs and Add song with { Liked = true } to a new List<Song>. Return the new list.
checks: Practice.LikeAll(new List<Song> { new Song(1, "Intro", false), new Song(2, "Finale", true) }).SequenceEqual(new List<Song> { new Song(1, "Intro", true), new Song(2, "Finale", true) })
checkLabels: Every song in the result must be liked, in the original order.
An empty list must give an empty list.
The list passed in must keep its original, not-liked song.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Replaces the items inside the list that was passed in.
Copies the list but never completes the songs.

feedback: Check two things separately: what the returned list holds, and what the list you were given holds afterwards.
